findings.evidence: The three content photographs are painted as CSS backgrounds on a figure/div (dom-1440: no img elements, backgroundImage on .hero__photo and .photo, no role or accessible name). The cup figures have figcaptions ('Six coffees a week', 'Sold in 250 g bags') but these caption facts, not the picture; the hero photo has nothing.
findings.after: inside each figure, or role="img" aria-label on the div if it must stay a background
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.1.1 Non-text Content: content images need a text alternative. Images were blocked at capture, so the element type was read from the DOM, not the pixels.
findings.title: Meaningful images get alt describing what they show

findings.evidence: focus.json stop 6 lands on the radio input itself, a 1x1px visually hidden element at x69 y2886; its focus crop (focus/06-on.png) shows only a corner of a border, and whether the visible label 'One 250 g bag' gains a ring could not be confirmed from the evidence. The ring colour on this band is oklch(0.94 0.02 80) (cream) against indigo, which would pass if it is drawn on the label.
findings.after: .seg input:focus-visible + label { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.94 0.02 80); outline-offset: 3px }
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 2.4.7 Focus Visible: focus on a hidden native radio must show on its visible proxy. Verify live; disputed until seen.
findings.title: Every interactive element has a visible :focus-visible ring at 3:1 against what it is draw

findings.evidence: At 375 the masthead links 'The day book' and 'Order' are display-hidden (dom-375 vis false, 0x0) with no menu replacing them; the only route to the order form from the top is the hero buttons.
